The [[Standard year/Legends|year]] '''3300 before the Battle of Yavin''' was a period of [[Time/Legends|time]]. Around that time, the environmental chaos on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[244Core|Sraato]] comes to an end, a period of turbulence caused by a [[Meteor/Legends|meteor]] five hundred years earlier.
